title: Let mercy stop the wavering
summary: The Lord Master is merciful before the mind has managed to settle. Let the repeated mercy of the Creator steady the place that keeps wavering.
takeaway: Let the Merciful Master steady the mind before it sways.
lifeApplication: When the mind begins to wobble, repeat the shabad's plain insistence: merciful, merciful. Let that be the first fact, not the fear.

source.shortMeaning: The shabad repeats the Lord's mercy until wavering has a truer fact to stand on.
source.lifeApplication: When the mind sways, begin with the repeated mercy of the One who made and still carries you.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad repeats the Lord's mercy until wavering has a truer fact to stand on.
evidence.turn: Let repeated mercy become the mind's first fact before fear interprets the day.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the mind begins to wobble, repeat the shabad's plain insistence: merciful, merciful. Let that be the first fact, not the fear.
